subproblem.title: Change of variables for τ(M, θ, ξ) under a dilation
subproblem.statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ, ξ : ℝ^N → NVector(ℝ^N, k), and let ω be any k-form on ℝ^N (DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k, with no regularity or support assumption). Put φ(x) := ρ • x, μ := μHE[k] and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k). Assume (H1) φ is a measurable embedding and (H2) φ is measure preserving from c • μ to μ. Then τ(M, θ, ξ) tested against x ↦ ρ^k ω(ρx) equals τ(φ(M), θ(ρ⁻¹·), ξ(ρ⁻¹·)) tested against ω: tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω. Here tauAction k S ϑ ζ α = ∫_{x ∈ S} ϑ(x)·ζ(x)(α(x)) dμ is a Bochner set integral, equal to 0 when the integrand is not integrable.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x : Eucl N => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, Steps 0(b) and 1. Here the measure facts come from the hypotheses (H1) and (H2); the parent discharges them with the sibling deformation_dilation_hausdorff. No sibling is used here.

Conventions.
- ℝ^N := Eucl N, μ := μHE[k], φ(x) := ρ • x and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k).
- M′ := φ(M), θ′(y) := θ(ρ⁻¹ • y) and ξ′(y) := ξ(ρ⁻¹ • y).
- (★) ρ⁻¹ • φ(x) = x for every x (inv_smul_smul₀, ρ ≠ 0). Hence θ′(φ x) = θ(x) and ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x).
- Unfold tauAction on both sides. The left side is ∫_{x ∈ M} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x). The right side is ∫_{y ∈ M′} θ′(y)·ξ′(y)(ω(y)) dμ(y).

1. Change of variables. For every g : ℝ^N → ℝ and every S ⊆ ℝ^N,
   ∫_{y ∈ φ(S)} g(y) dμ(y) = ∫_{x ∈ S} g(φ x) d(c • μ)(x).
   This is MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb applied to (H2), (H1), g and S. The identity of Bochner integrals needs no integrability hypothesis. It comes from the restriction of φ being a measure-preserving measurable embedding from (c • μ)|_S to μ|_{φ S}, for which ∫ g ∘ φ = ∫ g holds for every g (MeasurePreserving.integral_comp with a measurable embedding).

2. Scalar factor. (c • μ)|_S = c • (μ|_S) (Measure.restrict_smul), and ∫ h d(c • ν) = c.toReal·∫ h dν (integral_smul_measure). Also c.toReal = ρ^k, because ρ^k ≥ 0 (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal; nonnegativity by positivity or pow_nonneg hρ.le k). Hence ∫_{φ(S)} g dμ = ρ^k·∫_{x ∈ S} g(φ x) dμ(x).

3. Right side. Apply Steps 1–2 to g(y) := θ′(y)·ξ′(y)(ω(y)) and S := M:
   tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω = ∫_{φ(M)} g dμ
   = ρ^k·∫_{x ∈ M} θ′(ρ • x)·ξ′(ρ • x)(ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x)
   = ∫_{x ∈ M} ρ^k·(θ′(ρ • x)·ξ′(ρ • x)(ω(ρ • x))) dμ(x) (integral_const_mul, read right to left).

4. Pointwise comparison. Fix x. By (★), θ′(ρ • x) = θ(x) and ξ′(ρ • x) = ξ(x). Since ξ(x) is linear, ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x)) (map_smul, smul_eq_mul). So the left integrand θ(x)·ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = θ(x)·(ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x))). This equals the Step 3 integrand ρ^k·(θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x))) (ring).

5. Conclusion. The two set integrals over M have equal integrands at every point (congr; funext). Hence tauAction k M θ ξ (x ↦ ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω. ∎

theorem Submission.deformation_dilation_im_tauAction : ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → tauAction k M θ ξ (fun x : Eucl N => ρ ^ k • ω (ρ • x)) = tauAction k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) ω := by
  intro N k ρ M θ ξ ω hρ hemb hmp
  simp only [tauAction]
  rw [hmp.setIntegral_image_emb hemb (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y) * ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y) (ω y)) M,
    Measure.restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity),
    smul_eq_mul, ← integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp only [inv_smul_smul₀ hρ.ne', map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring
proof_key_steps: ∫_{φ(S)} g dμ = ∫_S g ∘ φ d(c • μ) for all g and S (MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb with (H1) and (H2); no integrability needed).
(c • μ)|_S = c • μ|_S, and ∫ h d(c • ν) = c.toReal·∫ h dν with c.toReal = ρ^k (restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure, toReal_ofReal).
Apply this to g = θ′·ξ′(·)(ω(·)) on S = M and move ρ^k inside the integral (integral_const_mul).
Pointwise, θ′(ρx) = θ(x) and ξ′(ρx) = ξ(x) (inv_smul_smul₀), and ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρx)) = ρ^k·ξ(x)(ω(ρx)) (map_smul); finish with ring and congr/funext.

audit.reason: The proposition matches the prose for arbitrary differential forms and arbitrary carrier and coefficient functions. The pinned change-of-variables and scalar-integral identities require no integrability assumption, so the proof also covers nonintegrable integrands. Inverse dilation and NVector linearity give the exact integrand equality. The supplied argument is complete, independent, and non-circular.
